## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changed behavior is covered by relevant tests (documentation-only changes do not need new tests)
- [ ] Ruff/Black/MyPy/pytest pass locally
- [ ] README/CHANGELOG updated (if needed)
- [ ] No breaking changes, or migration notes included
- [ ] System commands were mocked during validation; no real updates or repairs were run
- [ ] CLI output keeps fixed statuses, stable row order, and cancellable parallel audits (if affected)

## Validation

Provide commands and results used to validate the change. Distinguish mocked
integration coverage from any explicitly authorized VM/system checks, and note
checks that were not run. Follow [the contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
